# Synthetic geometry fixtures

These two OBJ files are original, synthetic test geometry; they contain no ACR
or other game-derived assets. Coordinates are metres with Z vertical.

- `road_surface.obj`: rectangular road surface at Z=2.
- `terrain_surface.obj`: larger flat ground plane at Z=0.

They validate the toolchain only. They do not reproduce an ACR road, terrain,
collision setup, or real-world terrain profile.
